threats.point: Profit is growing while operating cash flow is shrinking - an earnings-quality gap.

threats.point: The stock has a history of very deep drawdowns.
A fast-growing debt load raises the stakes on execution.
Receivables are stretching year on year.
Promoter selling is a warning about insider conviction.
A price that has outrun earnings needs the growth to catch up or it de-rates.
threats.evidence: Price grew 43% vs profit 39% (5Y) — stock ahead of fundamentals; watch valuation.

threats.point: Geopolitical tension, currency fluctuations, and cost pressures shaped up the operating environment.
